thread.title: Apple unveils new Mac Mini, which starts at $799 - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple unveils new Mac Mini, which starts at $799 - MarketWatch
text:
Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.57% on Tuesday unveiled a new version of the Mac Mini, which the company called "the biggest update ever" for the device. The Mac Mini starts with 32 gigabytes of memory but can go up to 64 GB. The device comes in a space gray finish and has four Thunderbolt 3 ports, two traditional USB-A ports, an HDMI port, and an Ethernet port. The device begins at $799, whereas the previous model started at $499. The Mac Mini goes on sale today and will be officially available on Nov. 7. Apple shares are little changed in Tuesday morning trading. They've gained 27% over the past 12 months, while the Dow DJIA, +0.83% of which Apple is a component, has climbed 5.2%.
